title: EPS bearer context modification initiated by the network

entities.name: EPS bearer context modification initiated by network
entities.description: Procedure where the MME initiates modification of an EPS bearer context by sending a MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message to the UE, starting timer T3486, and entering BEARER CONTEXT MODIFY PENDING state.

entities.name: MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by MME to UE to initiate EPS bearer context modification.

entities.name: MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT ACCEPT
entities.description: Message sent by UE to network to accept bearer context modification.

entities.name: MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by UE to network to reject bearer context modification.

entities.name: EPS bearer identity
entities.description: Identifies the EPS bearer context to be modified.

entities.name: Procedure transaction identity
entities.description: PTI value included when procedure was initiated by UE requested bearer resource procedures.

entities.name: Header compression configuration
entities.description: Optional IE for re-negotiating header compression configuration.

entities.name: UE network capability
entities.description: Contains UE capability indicators for CIoT EPS optimizations.

entities.name: T3486
entities.description: Timer started by MME when initiating EPS bearer context modification.

entities.name: BEARER CONTEXT MODIFY PENDING
entities.description: State entered by MME when EPS bearer context modification is pending.

entities.name: CIoT EPS optimization supported condition
entities.description: Condition where UE indicated support for Control plane CIoT EPS optimization and Header compression for control plane CIoT EPS optimization in UE network capability IE.

relations.description: Procedure includes sending MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message.
Procedure requires entering BEARER CONTEXT MODIFY PENDING state.
Message contains EPS bearer identity IE.
Message may contain PTI IE when initiated by UE requested procedures.
Message may contain Header compression configuration IE under CIoT optimization conditions.
Inclusion of Header compression configuration IE is guarded by CIoT optimization support condition.
Condition depends on UE network capability IE values.
MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT ACCEPT message stops timer T3486.
MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT message stops timer T3486.
